steps.en: PLUS sends a mention outcome update request to OCMS
steps.id: PLUS mengirim request update hasil mention ke OCMS
steps.why_en: No interface accepts a mention outcome from PLUS.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada antarmuka yang menerima hasil mention dari PLUS.

steps.en: OCMS checks the notice stage against the requested outcome
steps.id: OCMS memeriksa stage notice terhadap hasil mention yang diminta
steps.why_en: Stage rules exist only for suspensions, not outcomes.
steps.why_id: Aturan stage hanya untuk suspension, bukan hasil mention.

steps.en: OCMS checks how many times the case was adjourned
steps.id: OCMS memeriksa berapa kali kasus ditunda
steps.why_id: Penundaan sidang tidak dihitung di mana pun.

steps.en: OCMS decides whether the requested outcome can be applied
steps.id: OCMS memutuskan apakah hasil mention boleh diterapkan
steps.why_en: No decision logic exists for mention outcomes.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada logika keputusan untuk hasil mention.
